# Option 1 Builders

> Encino, California company specializing in artificial grass installation for homeowners across the San Fernando Valley and greater Los Angeles. Also installs paver patios and hardscape, and completes front and back yard transformations. In business since 2002 with more than 1,000 completed projects. Licensed, bonded and insured (CA license #1122918). Artificial grass installations are backed by a 15-year warranty.

## Services

- Artificial grass installation - pet turf, putting greens, play areas, front and back yards, old turf removal and replacement. 15-year warranty.
- Paver installation and hardscape - paver patios, walkways, driveways, pool decks, retaining and seat walls.
- Landscape design and installation - complete front and back yard transformations combining turf, hardscape, planting, irrigation, and drainage.
- Stepping stones and pathways - stone and paver paths set through turf, gravel, or planting beds.
- Concrete, decomposed granite (DG), gravel, and mulch - low-maintenance ground cover and patio surfaces.
- Irrigation, drainage, and vinyl fencing - sprinkler and drip systems, yard drains, privacy fencing.

## Materials and suppliers

- Hardscape and pavers: ORCO Pavingstones, Belgard, Angelus Block.
- Turf and landscape supply: Turf Distributors, Ewing Outdoor Supply, SiteOne Landscape Supply.
- Irrigation and drainage: NDS, Rain Bird, Hunter.

## How the company works

Every homeowner works with a single project manager from the first walkthrough through the final cleanup, rather than a call center or rotating salespeople. Every project starts with a free on-site consultation and measurement. Before demolition begins, the homeowner receives a written proposal naming materials, base depth, drainage plan, timeline, and price. Materials can be reviewed in person at the Encino showroom. Installation is performed by in-house crews rather than subcontractors, and each project ends with a final walkthrough.
